grades.quote: Typically such implementations do not have caches and thus may not be able to naturally support the LR/SC instructions provided by the Zalrsc extension.
grades.reason: The passage covers Zaamo AMOs, not LR/SC, which is the direct RISC-V counterpart of ARM load-exclusive/store-exclusive. It names LR/SC (Zalrsc) only in passing, as an alternative to AMOs. It also gives an AMO-based spinlock example (amoswap.w.aq/rl). That is related context for lock implementation, but it does not explain the LR/SC analogue.
The passage is about Smepmp PMP rationale (M-mode lockdown, pmpcfg.L). It says nothing about atomics, LR/SC, or locks.
